description: Find real open dates, or start times on one date, for a booking at a postal code. Without `date`: the open dates in the next 14 days. With `date` only: that day's start times, each with its price. With `date` and `end_date`: the open dates in that range (at most 14 days). Times are not held here: the customer picks the time on the checkout page, which holds it for 7 minutes.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. With date, return open dates in the range instead of times.

frequency.description: Cleaning only: one-time, weekly, or bi-weekly (every 2 weeks).

hours.description: Cleaning only: visit length in hours (see find_services for the lengths we sell, e.g. 2, 3 or 4).

job_type.description: Aircon only: the job, e.g. general_service, chemical_wash, chemical_overhaul (see find_services).

service.description: cleaning = home cleaning by the hour; aircon = aircon servicing, priced per job and number of units.

unit_count.description: Aircon only: number of aircon units (fan coils).

name: find_times
title: Find open dates and start times
